model.title: GOOD Act
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Ron Johnson (R-WI)

summary.text: The bill would require federal agencies to make their guidance documents more accessible to the public by posting them online when issued, maintaining a single centralized location where all current guidance documents can be found, and clearly marking which documents are no longer in effect. It also requires agencies to organize these documents by category and subcategory to make them easier to search and navigate.
